description: Get the trading account details (cash, buying power, equity, status).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the account object.

description: List all open positions in the account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of position objects.

description: Get the open position for a single symbol.

symbol.description: The ticker symbol of the position.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the position object; on failure (no position), output contains an error message.

description: List orders, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Optional status filter: 'open', 'closed', 'all', or a specific order status.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of order objects.

description: Get a single order by its id.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the order object; on failure (order not found), output contains an error message.

description: Submit a new buy or sell order; buys validate buying power, sells validate the held position.

qty.description: The quantity to trade (must be positive).

limit_price.description: Optional limit price for limit orders.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created order object; on failure (validation error), output contains an error message.

description: Cancel an open order by its id.

order_id.description: The id of the order to cancel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output confirms the canceled order; on failure (not found or not cancelable), output contains an error message.

description: List tradable assets, optionally filtered by status and asset class.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of asset objects.

description: Get the latest market quote for a symbol.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the symbol and quote (bid/ask); on failure (no quote), output contains an error message.
